signatures_searched.S1_original: ORION turns raw research trajectories into verified reusable methods that causally improve fresh research performance across cycles while remaining epistemically governed.
signatures_searched.S2_narrowed: A typed route/action state is information-sufficient for governance distinctions that named simpler projections provably cannot represent, on a generated case family.
signatures_searched.why_two: The gate audit (GATE_FALSIFIABILITY_AUDIT.json) showed that the four accuracy-shaped metrics backing S1's empirical leg cannot fail. What the evidence actually supports is S2, so the parent search must cover S2's signature and not only S1's.

verified_parents.citation: Yan Zhang, Shibo Li. ConsistencyGate: Preventing Memory Contamination in LLM Agents via Self-Consistency Admission Control. arXiv:2607.22962, submitted 25 Jul 2026.
verified_parents.occupies: write-time admission gate on agent memory — the closest published parent to RAKL's verification/negative-history admission of experience before reuse
verified_parents.mechanism: queries the LLM K times for a soft support score before committing a candidate fact, admitting only when the average exceeds a threshold; model-agnostic, no fine-tuning; log-probability single-pass variant
verified_parents.discriminator: ConsistencyGate's admission criterion is an LLM self-consistency score. RAKL's is an evidence-bound typed gate over verification, scope, version, refutation, lineage, target context, failure signature, strategy family and negative history, with CANNOT_CHECK as a first-class returned action rather than a low score. The contrast is exactly the LLM-judge-versus-evidence-gate axis that issue #588 flags for MEC-DARWINIAN_WORKFLOW_EVOLUTION.
verified_parents.obligation: ABSORB_AS_REQUIRED_BASELINE. This is a material threat to absorb, not a boundary to retreat from: any Paper III claim about admission gating must now beat a self-consistency admission gate, and must do so on a benchmark where the two are matched on cost. It releases three benchmarks (LoCoMo-Contam, MSC-Contam, MemContam) and the gate implementation, so the baseline is constructible.

verified_parents.citation: Hanrong Zhang, Shicheng Fan, Henry Peng Zou, Yankai Chen, Zhenting Wang, Jiayu Zhou, Chengze Li, Wei-Chieh Huang, Yifei Yao, Kening Zheng, Xue (Steve) Liu, Xiaoxiao Li, Philip S. Yu. CoEvoSkills: Self-Evolving Agent Skills via Co-Evolutionary Verification. arXiv:2604.01687, v1 2 Apr 2026, v3 revised 10 Aug 2026.
verified_parents.occupies: S1 directly — an agent autonomously constructing and iteratively refining reusable multi-file method artifacts, gated by a verifier that co-evolves with the generator
verified_parents.mechanism: a Skill Generator that iteratively refines skills coupled with a Surrogate Verifier that co-evolves to provide feedback without access to ground-truth test content
verified_parents.discriminator: The Surrogate Verifier is explicitly stated to operate without ground-truth access, so its promotion signal is a learned surrogate. RAKL's promotion requires an evidence certificate and forbids promotion on a model's own assessment. That is a real difference in kind, but it is a difference in the promotion signal, not in the method-evolution architecture, which CoEvoSkills already occupies.
verified_parents.cannot_check: Whether the Surrogate Verifier's fitness criterion admits an exact/executable component was not determinable from the abstract. The discriminator above is stated at abstract level only and MUST be confirmed against the full paper before any novelty claim rests on it.
verified_parents.obligation: ABSORB. Paper III's method-evolution framing can no longer be presented as unoccupied. The defensible position is the promotion-signal distinction, and that position is currently CANNOT_CHECK at the level of detail required.
verified_parents.note: The web search surfaced this as 'EvoSkills'. The verified title is 'CoEvoSkills'. Recorded because citing the search-surfaced name would have been a mis-citation.

verified_parents.citation: Hanxiang Chao, Yihan Bai, Rui Sheng, Tianle Li, Yushi Sun. STALE: Can LLM Agents Know When Their Memories Are No Longer Valid? arXiv:2605.06527, submitted 7 May 2026.
verified_parents.occupies: the version_current / not_refuted coordinates of RAKL's typed experience state — detecting that a stored memory has been invalidated
verified_parents.reported_result: 400 expert-validated conflict scenarios, 1200 evaluation queries, three probing dimensions (State Resolution, Premise Resistance, Implicit Policy Adaptation); best model 55.2% overall accuracy; prototype CUPMem uses structured state consolidation and propagation-aware search
verified_parents.why_it_matters_both_ways: It is a threat because the staleness coordinate is independently identified and benchmarked, and because CUPMem's 'structured state consolidation' is close to RAKL's structured route/action state. It is an opportunity because it is an externally constructed benchmark with a published 55.2% ceiling — precisely the kind of independent, non-self-generated evaluation surface Paper III currently lacks.
verified_parents.obligation: EVALUATE_ON_IT. This is the strongest candidate found for giving Paper III an external, non-self-generated evaluation surface without waiting on the blocked Stage-4 LUNARC qualification.

verified_parents.citation: Qisheng Hu, Quanyu Long, Wenya Wang (Nanyang Technological University). When Continual Learning Moves to Memory: A Study of Experience Reuse in LLM Agents. arXiv:2604.27003, 29 Apr 2026.
verified_parents.occupies: the experience-representation axis of Paper III's declared successor ('isolate typed trajectory-to-lesson induction before raw-language induction')
verified_parents.reported_result: a (k,v) framework separating how experience is represented from how it is organized for retrieval; across ALFWorld and BabyAI, abstract procedural memories transfer more reliably than detailed trajectories, and negative transfer disproportionately harms the hard cases
verified_parents.why_it_matters: This is a published empirical answer, on external benchmarks, to a question Paper III has registered as future work. Paper III's successor plan must cite it and state what it adds, or the successor is a replication.

verified_parents.citation: Lihong Li, Thomas J. Walsh, Michael L. Littman. Towards a Unified Theory of State Abstraction for MDPs. Reported by search as ISAIM 2006.
verified_parents.cannot_check: The exact venue/year string was not confirmed against the publisher record. It must be verified before appearing in a bibliography.
verified_parents.occupies: S2 — the NARROWED claim — closely and classically
verified_parents.threat_level_history: First recorded as RED_FOR_THE_NARROWED_CLAIM, then softened after measuring the grouping key — see exact_correspondence_qualifier below. The original assessment is preserved rather than overwritten.
verified_parents.why: Paper III's surviving result is that grouping cases on a field subset and taking the majority label yields an information ceiling below 1.0 for named projections and exactly 1.0 for the full coordinate set. That is structurally a state-abstraction sufficiency argument: which aggregations of state preserve the optimal action. Li, Walsh and Littman formalize this family, giving five abstraction classes (model-irrelevance through policy-irrelevance) and analyzing which preserve optimality.

exact_correspondence_qualifier.finding: information_ceiling groups on (family,) + projected_fields. `family` is the generator's construction label, not part of any parent's declared visible state, so every parent projection is granted information it would not actually have. The grouping is therefore a family-conditioned abstraction, not a clean state-only policy-irrelevance abstraction, and the correspondence to the classical result is close but not exact.
exact_correspondence_qualifier.measured_direction: CONSERVATIVE — removing `family` from the key LOWERS every parent ceiling, so the reported lossiness understates the real gap.
exact_correspondence_qualifier.corroborating_detail: The typed arm's ceiling is unchanged at 1.0 with or without `family`, which independently confirms that strict_action is a pure function of the state coordinates alone — the same fact that makes the four typed metrics a self-identity.
exact_correspondence_qualifier.consequence_for_the_claim: The projection-lossiness result survives and is in fact stronger than reported (1.0 versus 0.656, not 1.0 versus 0.714). What must be qualified is the mapping onto the classical theorem, not the measurement.

verified_parents.what_this_does_not_do: It does not refute the Paper III result. The classical setting has no CANNOT_CHECK action, no negative-history block, no successor-lineage semantics and no notion of an authority-bearing versus proposal-only decision. Those are genuine additions.
verified_parents.obligation: CITE_AND_STATE_THE_DELTA. The narrowed claim cannot be published as novel without positioning against this parent. The defensible delta is the governance semantics — CANNOT_CHECK as a first-class action and refusal-preserving abstraction — not the sufficiency analysis itself.

verdict_on_signature_occupancy.S1_original: OCCUPIED. CoEvoSkills occupies the self-evolving verified method-library architecture; ConsistencyGate occupies the admission gate. Paper III's method-evolution signature is contested, in the same way causal transportability contested Paper II's.
verdict_on_signature_occupancy.S2_narrowed: CLOSELY ADJACENT TO A CLASSICAL PARENT. The information-sufficiency argument sits in the MDP state-abstraction family, though the exact correspondence is qualified because the grouping key includes the generator's family label. The surviving novelty is narrower still: refusal-preserving and negative-history-preserving abstraction, where CANNOT_CHECK is an action the abstraction must not erase.
verdict_on_signature_occupancy.consequence: Neither occupancy is a reason to retreat. Both are absorbable, and in each case the discriminator is the same one: RAKL's promotion signal is evidence-bound and admits CANNOT_CHECK, where every parent found uses a learned or model-derived score with no refusal semantics. That single axis is now the load-bearing novelty claim for Paper III and it is currently untested against any of these parents.
